definitions.content: difference between the error of indication and the intrinsic error of a measuring instrument

notes.content: Principally a fault is the result of an undesired change of data contained in, or flowing through, an electronic measuring instrument.
From the definition, it follows that a "fault" is a numerical value which is expressed either in a unit of measurement or as a relative value, for instance as a percentage.

definitions.content: Wert zur Abgrenzung nicht signifikanter Fehler [VIML 5.13]
